<mxfile host="draw.io"> <diagram name="GitOps Application Flow" id="gitops-flow"> <mxGraphModel dx="1600" dy="900" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1800" pageHeight="1000" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0"/> <mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>
<!-- ========== Entry Points (left side) ========== --> <mxCell id="dev" value="Developer" style="shape=actor;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="200" width="80" height="80" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="git" value="GitLab
Repository" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="40" width="120" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- bootstrap_applications --> <mxCell id="bootstrap" value="bootstrap_applications
(Ansible role)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="240" y="210" width="180" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- ========== ArgoCD Namespace ========== --> <mxCell id="argocd_ns" value="argocd namespace" style="swimlane;startSize=25;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="500" y="30" width="260" height="200" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="argocd" value="ArgoCD Server" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="argocd_ns"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="40" width="220" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sshkey" value="SSH Deploy Key
(Secret)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#666666;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="argocd_ns"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="100" width="100" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="appproj" value="AppProject
homelab" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#666666;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="argocd_ns"> <mxGeometry x="140" y="100" width="100" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- ========== 1st Order: cluster-apps ========== --> <mxCell id="tier1" value="1st Order: cluster-apps" style="swimlane;startSize=25;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="500" y="280" width="260" height="80" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cluster_apps" value="cluster-apps
Application CR" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier1"> <mxGeometry x="50" y="35" width="160" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- ========== 2nd Order: Tiers ========== --> <mxCell id="tier2" value="2nd Order: Tiers" style="swimlane;startSize=25;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="840" y="160" width="260" height="300" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="infra" value="cluster-infra
(sync wave 1)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier2"> <mxGeometry x="50" y="40" width="160" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="platform" value="cluster-platform
(sync wave 4)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier2"> <mxGeometry x="50" y="240" width="160" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="wave_arrow" value="waits until
infra Healthy" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#b85450;fontSize=9;fontStyle=2;" vertex="1" parent="tier2"> <mxGeometry x="60" y="130" width="140" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_wave" edge="1" source="infra" target="platform" parent="tier2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;dashed=1;strokeColor=#b85450;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- ========== 3rd Order: Infra Apps ========== --> <mxCell id="tier3i" value="3rd Order: Infra Apps (9)" style="swimlane;startSize=25;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1180" y="40" width="320" height="300" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="certmgr" value="cert-manager (wave 1)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3i"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="35" width="130" height="30" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="trustmgr" value="trust-manager (wave 1)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3i"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="35" width="130" height="30" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cnpg" value="cloudnative-pg (wave 1)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3i"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="80" width="130" height="30" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rookop" value="rook-operator (wave 1)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3i"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="80" width="130" height="30" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rookcl" value="rook-cluster (wave 1)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3i"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="125" width="130" height="30" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="harbor" value="harbor (wave 2)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3i"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="125" width="130" height="30" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="keycloak" value="keycloak (wave 3)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3i"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="170" width="130" height="30" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="argooidc" value="argocd-oidc (wave 3)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3i"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="170" width="130" height="30" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dragonfly" value="dragonfly (wave 1)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3i"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="210" width="130" height="30" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <!-- Sveltos alternative note --> <mxCell id="sveltos_note" value="With ENABLE_SVELTOS=true:
Sveltos ClusterProfiles replace
sync waves with dependency-
ordered deployment" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#999999;fontColor=#666666;fontSize=9;fontStyle=2;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" vertex="1" parent="tier3i"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="250" width="280" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- ========== 3rd Order: Platform Apps ========== --> <mxCell id="tier3p" value="3rd Order: Platform Apps (10)" style="swimlane;startSize=25;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1180" y="350" width="320" height="270" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="grafana" value="grafana" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3p"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="35" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="thanos" value="thanos" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3p"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="75" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="alertmgr" value="alertmanager" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3p"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="115" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="matrix" value="matrix" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3p"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="155" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="otel" value="otel-collector" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3p"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="195" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nodeexp" value="node-exporter" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3p"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="35" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ksm" value="kube-state-metrics" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3p"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="75" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="metricsrv" value="metrics-server" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3p"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="115" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="matrixbr" value="matrix-bridge" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3p"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="155" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dcgm" value="dcgm-exporter" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="tier3p"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="195" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- ========== Edges ========== --> <!-- Developer → bootstrap_applications --> <mxCell id="e_dev_bootstrap" edge="1" source="dev" target="bootstrap" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_dev_bootstrap_l" value="setup-applications.py" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_dev_bootstrap"> <mxGeometry x="-0.1" relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<!-- bootstrap → cluster-apps --> <mxCell id="e_bootstrap_t1" edge="1" source="bootstrap" target="cluster_apps" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_bootstrap_t1_l" value="kubectl apply" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_bootstrap_t1"> <mxGeometry x="-0.1" relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<!-- ArgoCD → GitLab --> <mxCell id="e_argocd_git" edge="1" source="argocd" target="git" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_argocd_git_l" value="SSH poll" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_argocd_git"> <mxGeometry x="-0.2" relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<!-- ArgoCD manages cluster-apps --> <mxCell id="e_argocd_t1" edge="1" source="argocd" target="cluster_apps" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;dashed=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_argocd_t1_l" value="manages" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_argocd_t1"> <mxGeometry x="-0.2" relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<!-- cluster-apps → cluster-infra --> <mxCell id="e_t1_t2i" edge="1" source="cluster_apps" target="infra" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- cluster-apps → cluster-platform --> <mxCell id="e_t1_t2p" edge="1" source="cluster_apps" target="platform" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- cluster-infra → Infra Apps --> <mxCell id="e_infra_t3i" edge="1" source="infra" target="tier3i" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- cluster-platform → Platform Apps --> <mxCell id="e_plat_t3p" edge="1" source="platform" target="tier3p" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
</root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
